description: This file provides utility functions for color generation based on status strings and arbitrary identifiers. It is used for mapping categories or statuses to specific or deterministic pastel HSL colors, ensuring consistent coloring for statuses and categories within a dark-themed dashboard.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining consistent saturation and lightness.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a themed color; uses predefined mappings for common statuses, or falls back to a deterministic color generated from the string if unknown.
